title: Stonean tests detect epimorphisms of relative continuous module sheaves
statement: Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $P$ be a profinite space and $T$ a topological commutative ring. On the site $\operatorname{Prof}/P$ with finite jointly surjective coverings let $R_T(Q\to P)=C(Q,T)$, as in [def-sfb-relative-finite-bundle-model]. For a morphism $f:M\to N$ of ordinary $R_T$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $f$ is an epimorphism if and only if $M(Q)\to N(Q)$ is surjective for every $Q\to P$ whose profinite domain is extremally disconnected (the closure of every open subset is open). There is no finiteness condition on $M$, $N$, or their scalar actions.

proof.text: The faithful exact forgetful functor to abelian sheaves preserves and reflects epimorphisms: cokernels and their vanishing can be detected after forgetting. Use the local-surjectivity criterion for epimorphisms of abelian sheaves.

Suppose f is epic and fix a section over a Stonean test S. Local surjectivity gives lifts on a finite jointly surjective covering S_j -> S. Its finite disjoint union V is profinite and V -> S is surjective. The covering by disjoint clopen summands has empty pairwise intersections; the sheaf condition identifies sections on V with the product of sections on S_j, including the fact that sections on the empty test form the zero group. Thus the local lifts give a section b on V with f(b) the restriction of the original section.

Stonean projectivity supplies a continuous section sigma of V -> S. Since V -> P is the composite through S, sigma is also a morphism over P. Restrict b along sigma and use naturality to obtain a lift on S.

Conversely fix a section over any Q -> P. The Stonean-cover theorem gives a surjective continuous S -> Q with S Stonean. Compose with Q -> P to put S in the slice. The hypothesized surjectivity on S gives a local lift of the original section. This is local surjectivity on every test, hence the abelian sheaf map and then f are epic. The construction includes empty tests and zero module sheaves.

theorem relativeContinuousRing_epi_iff_stonean
    (P : Profinite.{u}) (T : Type v) [TopologicalSpace T] [CommRing T]
    [IsTopologicalRing T]
    {M N : SheafOfModules.{max u v + 1} (relativeContinuousRing P T)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    Epi f ↔ ∀ (Q : Over P) [ExtremallyDisconnected Q.left],
      Function.Surjective (f.val.app (op Q))
